definition_one_sentence: A registered customer account that placed at least one non-cancelled order during the last 12 rolling months.
formula_or_rule: COUNT(order_id WHERE status != 'cancelled' AND order_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '12 months') >= 1
example: Customer 10042 with a delivered order on 2026-09-15 is active on 2026-11-25; a customer with only cancelled orders or last order on 2025-05-01 is not.
notes_conflicts: Settles Sales (6m) vs Finance (12m) conflict: 12m non-cancelled is the enterprise KPI; Sales uses a separate term 'recently_active_customer_6m' for seasonal campaigns.

definition_one_sentence: Total sales revenue generated by an order after deducting refunds and excluding 20% VAT, with shipping fees included.
example: An order of 120.00 EUR (VAT incl.) with 0.00 EUR refund yields 100.00 EUR net revenue; an order of 240.00 EUR with a 60.00 EUR refund yields 150.00 EUR.
notes_conflicts: Settles Sales (incl. VAT) vs Finance (excl. VAT) conflict: VAT belongs to the state so net revenue is strictly excl. VAT; Sales commissions use VAT-included net sales.

definition_one_sentence: A previously active customer who has placed at least one non-cancelled order in the past but has had zero non-cancelled orders in the last 12 months.
formula_or_rule: lifetime_non_cancelled_orders >= 1 AND last_non_cancelled_order_date < CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '12 months'
example: Customer 10089 ordered once on 2025-08-10 and placed no order since; on 2026-11-25 they are classified as churned.
notes_conflicts: Used as target label in churn_prediction_model; excludes prospects who never completed a valid purchase.

definition_one_sentence: A unique registered user account in ShopFast's e-commerce platform capable of placing orders.
formula_or_rule: DISTINCT customer_id in dim_customers (deduplicated from raw.customers)
example: Account customer_id = 10042 (marie.dupont@example.fr, signed up 2026-03-12) represents one customer record.
notes_conflicts: Represents an account rather than a physical person; one individual may own multiple accounts with different email addresses.

definition_one_sentence: A commercial purchase transaction submitted by a customer through web, mobile app, or marketplace.
formula_or_rule: DISTINCT order_id in fct_orders with lifecycle status in (pending, shipped, delivered, cancelled, returned)
example: Order order_id = 800125 placed on 2026-11-10 via web for 184.31 EUR gross (status: delivered).
notes_conflicts: Includes all order statuses in operational tables; financial KPIs filter out status = 'cancelled'.
